cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is the Mauritius Revenue Authority's national Tax Payer Portal, a central system not stated as collecting any council revenue; the National Electronic Licensing System for permits through the local authorities; I-Council, a document and project system in 12 local authorities; and a cashier system of the Judiciary. Whether any council keeps a digital revenue register or receipt record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. Permit, document and central systems are noted classes and place nothing.
